in_hebrew.name: Hardie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hardie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word ‘heard’, meaning ‘brave, hardy’. The name Hardie was common during the Middle Ages and was often given to strong, courageous warriors.
